markerProtocol.postMarkerRule: After revision 3 is committed and exact readback succeeds, the single POST attempt is consumed. If the process crashes after marker creation, or the marker already exists and no exact terminal event is visible, never POST again.
markerProtocol.event: Use the existing ADS v4.18 DISPATCH_STATE_CHANGED event with actor_role=scheduler and dispatch_state=DONE. Preserve the original #203 Claim and reservation evidence; bind the new recovery marker/proof in the event evidence and record its digest in the marker.
markerProtocol.finalCas: Only exactly one complete, exact, unedited native terminal event plus exact original Claim readback permits CAS mustMatchRevision=3 to TERMINAL_VERIFIED (revision 4), followed by exact public-API final row readback.

postMarkerBehavior: Revision 2 with no marker: perform all preflight checks, acquire/hold fence, then CAS the single-use marker.

Revision 3 with exact marker: read-only native reconciliation only. If exactly one complete exact event is present, finalize with CAS mustMatchRevision=3; otherwise remain UNKNOWN/PENDING and never publish.
Revision 4 TERMINAL_VERIFIED: read-only verify the exact event and return already verified; never publish.
Any other revision, malformed marker, row drift, fence loss, duplicate event, incomplete readback, CAS race or unknown external effect: preserve the row and return UNKNOWN.

failureSemantics.beforeMarker: No write and no POST; target remains revision 2 PENDING.
failureSemantics.markerWriteAmbiguous: No POST. Re-read public CAS; if exact marker exists, treat attempt as consumed and reconcile read-only only; if state cannot be proven, STOP.
failureSemantics.afterMarkerBeforePostCrash: Marker remains consumed; no retry or second POST is permitted.
failureSemantics.publisherThrowOrLostAck: No retry. Perform complete read-only native event reconciliation once; finalize only if the exact event is proven.
failureSemantics.finalCasAmbiguous: Read-only final row/event reconciliation only; never POST again.

validationPlan: Syntax/parse checks on all three changed files before any test or CI.
Exact target revision-2 row positive; every original Claim/reservation field mismatch denies with zero writes and zero POSTs.
Prior run.log missing, wrong SHA, wrong exact HEAD, nonzero publisher invocation or nonzero POST count denies before marker and POST.

Quiescence proof excludes exactly the target reservation once; any second reservation, writer, attempt, subprocess, effect or unresolved resource denies.
Fence stale, changed or released before final readback denies.
Marker CAS race, wrong revision, malformed marker or ambiguous marker readback never invokes publisher.
Marker present with absent event performs read-only reconciliation only and never POSTs.
Successful path produces exactly one publisher invocation and exactly one HTTP POST; exact native event readback and final CAS revision 4 are verified.

Public event contains only bounded allowlisted evidence; no token, proxy credential, private path or diagnostic dump.
Use public DomainHarness v0.10.3 CAS APIs only; no raw SQLite or direct store mutation.
